agents.empty.headline: No agent is known here
agents.empty.body: Daoris drives the agents this build carries and those a plugin declares, and this machine answered with none.
agents.none.headline: Choose an agent
agents.none.body: Its accounts, how they are used, its ways in and what it may do are on its page.
agents.gone.headline: This agent is no longer here
agents.gone.body: No way in this build carries, and no plugin installed here, reaches it now.
agents.window.warned: ahead of its pace, by its own word
agents.window.reached: limit reached, by its own word
agents.window.projected: about {{projected}} by now, projected from Daoris's own turns since
agents.window.unweighed: not projected: Daoris cannot weigh its turns since
agents.read.againTip: Asks {{agent}} about each of Daoris's accounts, one at a time. Your own sign-in is never asked. Opening this page asks no sign-in.
agents.read.nowTip: Reads how much each account has used from {{agent}} now, where its reading is older than a minute: no prompt, and no model request. Opening this page reads it too.
agents.page.terminal: The same from a terminal: `daoris agent list` says each account, `daoris agent login {{agent}} --new` signs in to another, and `daoris agent profile …` sets how they are used.
agents.page.terminalAbsent: The same from a terminal: `daoris agent install {{agent}}`.
agents.page.installedByMaker: Daoris has no installer for {{product}}: it is installed with {{maker}}'s own tooling, and Daoris finds it once it is on this machine's PATH.
agents.page.installedByMakerUnnamed: Daoris has no installer for {{product}}: it is installed with its maker's own tooling, and Daoris finds it once it is on this machine's PATH.
agents.act.newKeyFor: Put a new API key into {{account}}
agents.terms.show: Each account's own plan and terms
agents.add.title: Add an account
agents.add.back: Signing an account back in? Use its row, so it stays the same account.
agents.add.signedInUnnamed: Signed in — the tool did not say who.
agents.add.name: Its name
agents.add.nameHint: One word a terminal can type. Left empty, it is called {{name}}.
agents.add.nameHintId: One word a terminal can type. Left empty, it is called {{name}}, and a terminal types its id, {{id}}.
agents.add.joined: {{account}} joined Daoris's accounts: every workspace's work may run on it.
agents.rename.title: Rename {{account}}
agents.unnamed: {{id}} has no name of its own now.
agents.pooled.title: Your {{product}} accounts now serve every workspace.
agents.pooled.ownList: {{workspace}} had its own accounts ({{accounts}}); it now runs on all {{count}}.
agents.pooled.oneAccount: {{workspace}} ran on {{account}} alone; it now runs on all {{count}}.
agents.pooled.unnamed: Workspaces that named no accounts ran on {{accounts}}; they now run on all {{count}}.
agents.pooled.unnamedOne: Workspaces that named no accounts ran on {{account}} alone; they now run on all {{count}}.
agents.pooled.inOrder: Their starts still begin at {{account}}, since the accounts are now used One by one, in order.
agents.pooled.moved: {{workspace}}'s starts began at {{account}}; it is number {{place}} in the order now.
agents.pooled.unnamedMoved: Starts of workspaces that named no accounts began at {{account}}; it is number {{place}} in the order now.
agents.pooled.joined: {{account}} was not in the order; it is number {{place}} now, and every workspace's work may run on it.
agents.pooled.notKeptUnnamed: Not kept: {{setting}} ({{value}}), set for workspaces that named no accounts.
agents.pooled.gone: {{account}} was named but is no account here, so it was left out.
agents.settings.actors: Used where an actor runs this agent on its account default; a model an actor names outranks it.
